editorial.blurb: KFire serves vibrant Korean bowls and tabletop BBQ in a casual, welcoming Logan Square spot where quality ingredients and friendly service make Korean cuisine feel approachable.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the KFIRE Balls and Bokki "fries" as appetizers—reviewers rave about their flavor—and ask about the Kalbi with marinated mushrooms if you want something beyond the build-your-own bowls.
signatureDishes: Kalbi with marinated mushrooms and corn salad
